# 1 Enoch Chapter 40 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 40:2 — "presences" vs. "beings"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "four-presences" | Literal; Ge'ez ṣewa' = presences, beings before the throne |
| LOGOS | "four presences" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "four special beings" | More accessible; "presences" sounds abstract |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Four presences" (LOGOS). The term has a specific resonance of divine throne-room attendance. "Beings" is more generic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 40:5 — "hang upon" vs. "depend upon" vs. "belong to"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "who-hang-upon the-Lord of-Spirits" | Literal; Ge'ez may imply attachment/dependency |
| LOGOS | "who depend upon the Lord of Spirits" | Interprets the idiom |
| PNEUMA | "who belong to the Lord of Spirits" | Simplified sense |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Who depend upon the Lord of Spirits" (LOGOS). "Hang upon" is too literal and awkward in English. "Belong to" loses the sense of reliance.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 40:7 — "driving away the adversaries" vs. "driving back the accusers"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "fending-off the-adversaries" | Literal compound; adversaries = satanic accusers |
| LOGOS | "driving away the adversaries" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "driving back the accusers" | "Accusers" makes the legal meaning explicit |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Driving away the adversaries" (LOGOS). "Adversaries" is the broader and more accurate rendering of the Ge'ez term, which includes but is not limited to legal accusation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 3**
